text:
sara: Quick heads-up — canary run for raven-v3q-int8 shows a 2.1% increase in funcall parse failures vs fp16. Sampled 5k requests.

mike: ugh. Is that on the same prompt set? any specific schema that failed?

sara: yes, same eval harness across 3 prompt families. Failures cluster around nested arrays and trailing commas in toolcall outputs. Parser logs: 
```
parser.ERROR: Unexpected token ']' at position 134 in payload
payload: {\"action\":\"invoke\",\"params\":[{\"id\":1},]}
```

anna: trailing comma is odd — quant shouldn't change text tokens. Could be tokenization shift causing comma to be emitted earlier.

david: runtime noticed more frequent early EOS tokens for int8 in the kvcache path. Might cause partial json and suffix fragments.

sara: can we reproduce deterministically? i have a failing example: prompt id 2026 in S3: s3://redwood-canary/runs/2026/post.json

mike: trying local repro with raven-lite-int8, running 1k seeds and capturing raw token stream.

ops-bot: Deploy started by @mike: canary container raven-lite-int8 @ commit b3f4a2 — ETA 12m :rocket:

mike: repro shows token stream snippets: '...','\"params\":[{\"id\":1},','\n','}]' — model inserts a comma then newline before closing array, causing strict JSON parse to fail.

anna: two options: 1) soft-parse tolerant mode (strip trailing commas + NDJSON fallback) 2) tune retry/backoff and prompt scaffolding to prefer explicit array endings.

david: adding a postprocess "comma-stripper" is cheap but risky; prefer a canary patch that: 1) increases retry attempts from 1->3 with small jitter, 2) enable JSON heal heuristics for canary only.

sara: agreed. create canary config + telemetry: record original token stream, repaired payload, and repair method. Also add an eval that tracks action fidelity (did repair change intended action?).

mike: PR incoming for retry & heuristic toggle. I'll include sampling code and a unit test with the failing prompt.

anna: also schedule a quantization micro-benchmark: run int8 vs fp16 on the same seed set and collect token alignment metrics and KL divergence on next-token distribution.

sara: thanks. if canary stable for 24h we'll roll; else roll back to fp16 canary. :thumbsup:

david: noted. logging: increased parse level to DEBUG for canary to capture suffix bytes.

sara: tagging @eng-platform and @support for visibility.
